name: Eduaide
summary: AI toolkit for teachers that generates lessons, questions, rubrics, supports and classroom images, with a document-chat assistant on Pro.
description: AI toolkit for teachers that generates lessons, questions, rubrics, supports and classroom images, with a document-chat assistant on Pro.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no credit card — up to 8 resources a month (24 credits) for core creation workflows. Pro 5 €/month or 45 €/year (officially also described as 4 €/month) — unlimited AI generations, Erasmus Document Chat, add questions, rubrics, reading supports, study tools and translations, turn evaluation feedback into revised resources, custom classroom images, YouTube transcripts as source material, reasoning model, more context (3× longer topic prompts, 5 standards, 3 uploaded documents). Regional pricing may appear at checkout. First Pro payment is eligible for a full refund within 14 days; renewals are not refundable. Cancel anytime and keep Pro until the paid period ends.
